cases.candidate_script:
set -u
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/dns-negative-cache-peer.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" authority "$HOME/authority.log" & peer=$!
trap 'kill "$peer" 2>/dev/null; wait "$peer" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
for ((i=0;i<100;i++)); do [ -s "$HOME/authority.log" ] && break; sleep 0.05; done
[ -s "$HOME/authority.log" ] || exit 98
export BASHDNS_SERVER_PORT=5342
dns resolver-serve --listen 127.0.0.1 --port 5343 --upstream 127.0.0.2 --max-queries 3 </dev/null 2>"$HOME/server.log" & srv=$!
for ((i=0;i<100;i++)); do
  ready=0
  while read -r slot local rest; do [[ $local == 0100007F:14DF ]] && ready=1; done < /proc/net/udp
  [ "$ready" = 1 ] && break
  kill -0 "$srv" 2>/dev/null || exit 98
  sleep 0.05
done
[ "$ready" = 1 ] || { kill "$srv" 2>/dev/null; wait "$srv" 2>/dev/null; exit 98; }
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" client "$HOME/authority.log" || { kill "$srv" 2>/dev/null; wait "$srv" 2>/dev/null; exit 1; }
wait "$srv" || exit 1
cases.purpose: CNAME plus NODATA cache TTL uses SOA MINIMUM, ages on cache hit and refetches after expiry.
cases.oracle: Independent minimal UDP authority provides CNAME TTL 10, SOA TTL 9 and SOA MINIMUM 4 and logs received queries; a separate client measures response TTL and upstream counts.
cases.comparison: Require all observations including upstream count; setup failure cannot pass.
